title: Financial Accounting and Reporting
overview: In today’s rapidly evolving accounting landscape, staying updated with the latest standards, regulations, and industry practices is essential. Professionals must continuously refine their skills to improve the quality of financial reporting, ensuring accurate recording, reporting, and disclosure of both routine and complex business transactions.

This course, Financial Accounting and Reporting, is designed and delivered by experts with extensive theoretical knowledge and practical global experience. It equips participants with the tools needed to produce high-quality financial statements and meet disclosure requirements effectively.
audience: Finance and accounting professionals at all levels.
Accountants seeking to deepen their practical knowledge of finance and accounting.
Certified financial and accounting professionals looking to enhance their reporting skills.
methodology: The course is delivered using a blend of interactive methods, including concise presentations, real-world applications of theoretical concepts, and group exercises to encourage collaboration and practical knowledge sharing.
competencies: Mapping trial balance accounts to financial statement accounts.
Preparing notes and disclosures for financial statements.
Leveraging Excel and Pivot Tables for effective financial reporting.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the structure and best presentation practices for core financial statements.
Recognize key periodical adjustments and their impact on financial statements.
Accurately account for assets, liabilities, equity, revenues, and expenses during routine and exceptional transactions.
Identify and apply minimum disclosure requirements for major accounts and transactions.
Prepare comprehensive financial statements from a raw trial balance, including all required disclosures.
